Blight Shadow.name: Blight Shadow
Blight Shadow.description: An invasive species from beyond our galaxy. They primarily survive by absorbing various forms of energy.

Blight Mutation.name: Blight Mutation
Blight Mutation.description: An invasive species from beyond our galaxy. They primarily survive by absorbing various forms of energy. These Blight Shadows have mutated into a stronger form that includes an organ to protect itself from incoming projectiles.

Blight Horror.name: Blight Horror
Blight Horror.description: An invasive species from beyond our galaxy. They primarily survive by absorbing various forms of energy. The Blight Horror has developed a special organ which allows the creature to generate bolts of red lightning that can interfere with mechanical devices. Unlike the energy absorption and draining organs that are used to gain sustenance, the primary purpose of this attack appears to be malicious vindictive destruction.

Blight Terror.name: Blight Terror
Blight Terror.description: An invasive species from beyond our galaxy. They primarily survive by absorbing various forms of energy. A Blight Shadow that has gorged itself on an unusual source of energy can become a Blight Terror, growing to an absurd size.

Osk Lek Chaser.name: Osk Lek Chaser
Osk Lek Chaser.description: A heavily modified Korath Chaser used as an escape vehicle by the Scrapyard Hermit.

Palavret Tek.name: Palavret Tek
Palavret Tek.description: Korath Scrappers who scavenge in the Scrapyard are using the technology they find to customize their ships.

Rano'erek Tek.name: Rano'erek Tek
Rano'erek Tek.description: Korath Scrappers who scavenge in the Scrapyard are using the technology they find to customize their ships. 	This Rano'erek Tek has enhanced shield strength and hull durability. Upgraded automation in its operations keeps the ships crew requirements low.

Rano'erek Ik.name: Rano'erek Ik
Rano'erek Ik.description: The dangers of scavenging in the Scrapyard has lead the captain of this Rano'erek Ik to make some modifications to its hull with a focus on strengthening the shields and expanding weapons capacity.

Mechanized Mine.name: Mechanized Mine
Mechanized Mine.description: An automated mine designed to create more mines. The Mereti developed this for deployment in distant systems controlled by hostile forces.

Grakerat 572.name: Grakerat 572
Grakerat 572.description: The Sestor deployed these expeditionary vessels centuries ago to extend their reach beyond Korath space. If one were to find a suitable planet to establish a base of operations on, the Sestor could rise again.

Skoretak 13.name: Skoretak 13
Skoretak 13.description: The Sestor stopped production of these interceptors a century ago. Their primary function was to serve as escorts for freighters.

Tercheldar 150.name: Tercheldar 150
Tercheldar 150.description: The Tercheldar 150 was a warship designed to fight in Mereti mine fields. It was eventually replaced by the more powerful Kar Ik Vot 349.

Stakoshtar 187.name: Stakoshtar 187
Stakoshtar 187.description: During their civil war, the Korath used this weapon against planetary targets. Scars from such battles still cover the surface of many of their worlds.

Eave-Skiff.name: Eave-Skiff
Eave-Skiff.description: The Eave-Skiff is a fighter carried by Kor Efret capital ships. 	Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay.

Vault-Barge.name: Vault-Barge
Vault-Barge.description: A precursor to the Korath World-Ship. As more of their people resettle onto their former worlds, there will be a demand for smaller ships. In anticpation of this, the Kor Efret shipyards have begun reproducing these smaller freighters.

Bravo-Monitor.name: Bravo-Monitor
Bravo-Monitor.description: A precursor to the Korath World-Ship. As more of their people resettle onto their former worlds, there will be a demand for smaller ships. In anticpation of this, the Kor Efret shipyards have begun reproducing these smaller patrol ships.

Delta-Ferry.name: Delta-Ferry
Delta-Ferry.description: A precursor to the Korath World-Ship. As more of their people resettle onto their former worlds, there will be a demand for smaller ships. In anticpation of this, the Kor Efret shipyards have begun reproducing these smaller transports.

Korath Ranger.name: Korath Ranger
Korath Ranger.description: The Threshold-Destroyer was the first warship deployed at the start of the Korath civil war that eventually brought the downfall of their civilization. With the recent Blight Shadow attack on one of their World-ships, the Kor Efret are starting to reproduce these warships as escorts.

Shelf-Sloop.name: Shelf-Sloop
Shelf-Sloop.description: The Kor Efret have redesigned an old warship for more peaceful pursuits. The Shelf-Sloop is able to install larger engines than its predecessor while also accomodating a turret. Its weapons options, however, are more limited.

Mereti Efret.name: Mereti Efret
Mereti Efret.description: Translated to "Mereti Friend", this is the first functional Korath spacecraft made entirely from salvaged Mereti parts. While not fully autonomous, it is very nearly so.

Korath Devourer.name: Korath Devourer
Korath Devourer.description: Some Korath scrappers are more interested in harvesting raw materials rather than technology. The Devar'ur is their attempt to streamline the collection process. The Korath Incinerator is integrated into the ship and cannot be removed.

Korath Explorer.name: Korath Explorer
Korath Explorer.description: Korath Explorers were originally made to escape the harsh gravitional forces of Sagittarius A*. It is a science vessel designed for gathering data and resources.

Scrap Metal.name: Scrap Metal
Scrap Metal.description: Twisted wreckage from a destroyed spacecraft or other artificial object.

Anomalous Husk.name: Anomalous Husk
Anomalous Husk.description: Trace amounts of dessicated biological residue are attached to this mass of glassy material. It appears to be well suited for absorbing heat, but otherwise does not appear to possess be any unusual physical properties.

Blood Lightning?.name: Blood Lightning?
Blood Lightning?.description: The red lightning generated from this organ will slightly recharge the batteries of a ship struck by it. This is accompanied by a weapon jamming effect similar to, but different from, ionization.

Korath Fireswarm Access Temporary Licens.name: Korath Fireswarm Access Temporary License
Korath Fireswarm Access Temporary Licens.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Fireswarm Missiles. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Fireswarm Missiles even if it is normally not stocked there. 	The version available for purchase is written in an alien language you don't understand... 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area when at the outfitter.

Korath Fireswarm Tech License.name: Korath Fireswarm Tech License
Korath Fireswarm Tech License.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Korath Fireswarms. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Korath Fireswarms even if it is normally not stocked there.

Automine Deployer.name: Automine Deployer
Automine Deployer.description: A newly developed Mereti weapon, the Automine Deployer forgoes the need to carry ammunition. Instead, the mines are constructed using Korath nanomachine technology. These weapons were developed exclusively for use by the Mechanized Mine automata.

Burrower Mining Beam.name: Burrower Mining Beam
Burrower Mining Beam.description: This classic Korath mining laser lacks the shield disruption effect found in its modern counterpart, but is more effective for its intended purpose.

Korath Eliminator.name: Korath Eliminator
Korath Eliminator.description: The World Slicer is an orbital strike weapon that can carve deep into a planet's crust. Many worlds were destroyed in the Korath civil war by these tools of destruction.

Korath Fireswarm Nest.name: Korath Fireswarm Nest
Korath Fireswarm Nest.description: These storage shells hold additional Fireswarm Missiles for the Fireswarm Launcher. 	Each Fireswarm Nest includes a power charger to keep stored Fireswarms ready for launch. They also plug into your ships power systems, allowing surplus energy to be used elsewhere.

Korath Fireswarm Depot.name: Korath Fireswarm Depot
Korath Fireswarm Depot.description: The Fireswarm Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Fireswarm Missiles. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to oversee maintenance of the ammunition.

Korath Fireswarm.name: Korath Fireswarm
Korath Fireswarm.description: Each Fireswarm Missile carries ten smaller missiles. When not being fired as weapons, they add to the energy storage capacity of your ship.

Korath Fireswarm Launcher.name: Korath Fireswarm Launcher
Korath Fireswarm Launcher.description: The Fireswarm Missile is a cluster munition that carries a swarm of smaller missiles which can overwhelm slow defense systems. 	If multiple Fireswarm Launchers are installed, they will all fire simultaneously.

Korath Grappler.name: Korath Grappler
Korath Grappler.description: Grappler Gun projectiles are designed to pull a target closer to the Korath ship, to keep it from escaping.

Korath Incinerator.name: Korath Incinerator
Korath Incinerator.description: A giant smelter. Ships and asteroids go in. Melted metal comes out.

Korath Scattermine.name: Korath Scattermine
Korath Scattermine.description: The Scattermine Deployer is a crude device for deploying a cloud of stationary mines along the ship's wake. One drawback of deploying the mines in this manner is that premature detonation can damage the ship dropping the mines.

Korath Tractor.name: Korath Tractor
Korath Tractor.description: The Salvager Turret is used to tow derelict ships away from dangerous battlefields.

Korath Tormentor.name: Korath Tormentor
Korath Tormentor.description: An ancient Korath design, the Tormentor lacks the burst fire and synchronization features which were later implemented in the Repeater.

Tormentor Turret.name: Tormentor Turret
Tormentor Turret.description: Tormentor Turrets only have a single Tormentor mounted on their base, but have low space requirements for installation.

Hyperdrive (Damaged).name: Hyperdrive (Damaged)
Hyperdrive (Damaged).description: A malfunction is causing this hyperdrive to consume triple the amount of fuel that a normal hyperdrive would.

Obsolete Transceiver.name: Obsolete Transceiver
Obsolete Transceiver.description: This is a miniaturized communication device, which can be connected to all the major systems of a Kor Sestor automaton, apparently as a way of controlling them remotely. This appears to be an older model transceiver incompatible with the encryption and authentication methods utilized by modern Kor Sestor.

Obsolete Transmitter.name: Obsolete Transmitter
Obsolete Transmitter.description: This is some sort of advanced, miniature computer combined with various sensor inputs. Presumably, in some way it controls nearby Sestor automata when communications over a hyperspace communications network are unavailable. This device is designed to interface with older model transceivers and is incompatible with the encryption and authentication methods utilized by modern Kor Sestor.

Triple Plasma Core (Damaged).name: Triple Plasma Core (Damaged)
Triple Plasma Core (Damaged).description: While there is no visible damage, you are certain this unit is malfunctioning. The power output is no better than a Double Plasma Core.

Afterburner (Meteor Class).name: Afterburner (Meteor Class)
Afterburner (Meteor Class).description: This older afterburner design was once a common sight in Korath space. 	Korath afterburners pump super-heated hyperspace fuel directly into a thruster's plasma stream, resulting in a phenomenal explosion that nearly melts the thruster.

Arkrof GP Hybrid Reverser.name: Arkrof GP Hybrid Reverser
Arkrof GP Hybrid Reverser.description: Efreti engineers have adapted their smallest gravitoplasma-based thrusters into this reverser. 	This Korath engine has been modified to be partially installed in a ship's weapon space, allowing it to push the ship in reverse.

Farves GP Hybrid Reverser.name: Farves GP Hybrid Reverser
Farves GP Hybrid Reverser.description: Reversers aren't particularly popular among the Kor Efret, yet Efreti factories still produce them for a niche market. 	This Korath engine has been modified to be partially installed in a ship's weapon space, allowing it to push the ship in reverse.

Gaktem GP Hybrid Reverser.name: Gaktem GP Hybrid Reverser
Gaktem GP Hybrid Reverser.description: Efreti reverse thrusters are just as powerful as their normal gravitoplasma thrusters. 	This Korath engine has been modified to be partially installed in a ship's weapon space, allowing it to push the ship in reverse.

Nelmeb GP Hybrid Reverser.name: Nelmeb GP Hybrid Reverser
Nelmeb GP Hybrid Reverser.description: These are the largest gravitoplasma reversers that the Efreti have to offer. 	This Korath engine has been modified to be partially installed in a ship's weapon space, allowing it to push the ship in reverse.

Steering (Planetary Class)(Damaged).name: Steering (Planetary Class)(Damaged)
Steering (Planetary Class)(Damaged).description: A malfunction in the steering system has reduced its effectiveness significantly.

Thruster (Planetary Class)(Damaged).name: Thruster (Planetary Class)(Damaged)
Thruster (Planetary Class)(Damaged).description: Damage to the thrusters has reduced output by half.

Blight Rifle.name: Blight Rifle
Blight Rifle.description: A prototype the Remnant created using Blight Shadow eggs. This weapon drains energy from whatever it is used on. This can disrupt electronic door locks and reduces living creatures into withered husks. This effect also replenishes its own energy, making it an exceptional weapon for long sieges. Death from this weapon appears to be cruel and painful. If the governments back home knew of its existence, it would probably be banned.

Korath Sentinel.name: Korath Sentinel
Korath Sentinel.description: A semi autonomous robot made with Sestor technology, these defense droids patrol high security areas on the ships of experienced Kor scrapper crews.

Slicer Torch.name: Slicer Torch
Slicer Torch.description: An improvised weapon made by a Scrapyard hermit. It easily and quickly cuts through ship bulkheads, making it an ideal tool for raiding ships. It can also be used to make emergency escape routes when one is seemingly trapped in a dead end. This weapon can get incredibly hot after prolonged use, so it may be unwise to use it for defending against extended sieges.

Blight Shadow Eggs.name: Blight Shadow Eggs
Blight Shadow Eggs.description: Alien eggs found in a derelict space station. Might be worth something to the right person.

Node 8 Jammer.name: Node 8 Jammer
Node 8 Jammer.description: This resembles a clump of Kor Mereti Reasoning Nodes, but is an obvious fake when compared to the real thing. Despite this, it's a sophisticated piece of technology with the ability to disrupt communications on a network it's installed on.

Node 8 Processor.name: Node 8 Processor
Node 8 Processor.description: This resembles a clump of Kor Mereti Reasoning Nodes. It must be related to the Mereti communications network somehow.

Efret Salvage License.name: Efret Salvage License
Efret Salvage License.description: Gives you access to salvaged outfits from the Kor Efret. You're not sure if this is a formal license or simply a means to communicate to the outfitter that you're looking for used parts...

Korath Afterburner.name: Korath Afterburner
Korath Afterburner.description: Korath Scrappers recovered his small afterburner from the ruins of their ancestral space. 	Korath afterburners pump super-heated hyperspace fuel directly into a thruster's plasma stream, resulting in a phenomenal explosion that nearly melts the thruster.

Korath Smelter.name: Korath Smelter
Korath Smelter.description: A giant smelter. Ships go in. Melted metal comes out.
